1.

Up, my soul, to praise thy God For His great grace, For His Son, His precious gift, For His comfort and counsel! For His comfort and counsel!

2.

Christ has blotted out my sin, Granted me peace and light; Through the cross’s death He has opened The way to the Father’s house, The way to the Father’s house.

3.

Pure and free I now am become, Sonship I have received; Blessed already here on earth: What a glorious portion! What a glorious portion!

4.

Nothing can condemn me, Free from guilt I am. God can never forget me, I am dear to Him, I am dear to Him.

5.

Though in clouds He seems to hide, Yet He is near to me; Though trials may follow me, |: It is only love. :|

6.

Rejoice therefore, O my heart, Raise a joyful sound! Rejoice amid all thy sorrow, |: Rejoice in thy God! :|
